name: inline-completion
description: Minimal provider-agnostic inline code completion for OpenAI-compatible chat completion APIs.

commands.title: Inline Completion: Clear Stored API Key

inlineCompletion.model.description: Model ID used for inline completion.

inlineCompletion.apiKeySource.description: Read the API key from an environment variable or VS Code SecretStorage.

inlineCompletion.apiKeyEnvVar.description: Environment variable containing the API key when apiKeySource is environment.

inlineCompletion.systemPrompt.default: You are a precise, low-latency inline code editing engine. Infer the smallest locally useful edit from the code around TARGET. Respect the existing coding style and syntax. Be conservative: if the next edit is not strongly implied, make no suggestion.
inlineCompletion.systemPrompt.description: Custom system instructions. A strict JSON/whitespace response contract is appended automatically.

inlineCompletion.extraBody.description: Extra JSON properties merged into the request body, e.g. {"reasoning_effort": "none"}.

inlineCompletion.prefixChars.description: Maximum characters before the cursor sent as context.

inlineCompletion.suffixChars.description: Maximum characters after the cursor sent as context.

inlineCompletion.maxLines.description: Maximum number of completion lines shown as ghost text.

inlineCompletion.excludedLanguages.description: Language IDs where inline completion is disabled.

inlineCompletion.conservative.description: Suppress automatic requests in low-signal contexts such as empty top-level lines. Explicitly triggered inline suggestions still run.
